title: Branding APIs
description: Branding APIs enable you to customize all customer facing pages provided by Surfboard. The branding can be configured at various levels similar to the terminal config.

endpoints.fragment: Generate Branding with AI for Partner

apis.heading: Create Branding for Merchant
apis.description: Create a branding configuration for customizable pages at merchant level

reqParams.name: backgroundColor
reqParams.description: Background color for the page.

reqParams.name: brandColor
reqParams.description: Primary brand color for your page.

reqParams.name: footerColor
reqParams.description: Footer's background color on the page.

reqParams.name: accentColor
reqParams.description: This is a secondary color that complements your brand color.

reqParams.name: rectShape
reqParams.description: Decides the shape of the page buttons. The available shapes are 'ROUNDED', 'PILL' and 'EDGY'.

reqParams.name: fontType
reqParams.description: Font family for the customizable page. The available font types are 'sans-serif','serif' and 'mono'.

reqParams.name: logoUrl
reqParams.description: Logo that will be displayed on the page.

reqParams.name: iconUrl
reqParams.description: Icon that will be displayed on the page.

reqParams.name: primaryCoverImage
reqParams.description: Primary cover image that will be displayed on the page.

reqParams.name: secondaryCoverImage
reqParams.description: Secondary cover image that will be displayed on the page.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Generate Branding with AI for Partner
apis.description: Generate ready-to-use branding suggestions for a partner from a website. Supply the URL of a site and Surfboard analyzes it to propose one or more complete branding options — colors, button shape, font, logo and icon — that you can apply to a partner, merchant, store, or terminal.

reqParams.name: url
reqParams.description: Website address to derive branding suggestions from, for example the partner's marketing site. When omitted, an empty URL is used and generic suggestions are returned.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, indicated as either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The generated branding suggestions.

resParams.name: brandingOptions
resParams.description: The suggested branding configurations. Each entry is a complete set of branding values you can apply.

resParams.name: backgroundColor
resParams.description: Suggested background color for the page, as a hex color code.

resParams.name: brandColor
resParams.description: Suggested primary brand color, as a hex color code.

resParams.name: accentColor
resParams.description: Suggested secondary color that complements the brand color, as a hex color code.

resParams.name: rectShape
resParams.description: Suggested shape for the page buttons.

resParams.name: fontType
resParams.description: Suggested font family for the page.

resParams.name: logoUrl
resParams.description: URL of the suggested logo to display on the page.

resParams.name: iconUrl
resParams.description: URL of the suggested icon to display on the page.

resParams.name: footerColor
resParams.description: Suggested footer background color, as a hex color code.

resParams.name: metadata
resParams.description: Details about the generation run.

resParams.name: inputTokens
resParams.description: Number of input tokens consumed to generate the suggestions.

resParams.name: outputTokens
resParams.description: Number of output tokens produced while generating the suggestions.

resParams.name: outputType
resParams.description: The kind of output that was generated.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
